title_en: Take an Extra £10 Off Your Order on Top Switch 2 and PS5 Games When You Spend £69 at Amazon This Weekend — Nice.
summary_en: You can save £10 on top PS5, Switch 2, and Xbox games at Amazon UK when you spend £69 or more this weekend. Nice!
body_en:
Amazon UK has launched a brand new promotion that could be well worth a look if you're planning to pick up some new games, accessories, or other gaming gear. Spend more than £69 on eligible products, and Amazon will knock £10 off your total order , giving you a pretty easy way to save on some of the latest Switch 2, PS5, and Xbox releases.
There's a pretty decent selection of products included in the promotion, too. Some of the highlights I've spotted include Super Mario Galaxy 1+2 for £44.95, PS5 DualSense Controllers for £59.99, and Pokémon Legends Z-A for Switch 2 at just £42.95. There are plenty of other games, controllers, accessories, and more to choose from, so it's worth having a browse through the full selection before you check out.
The promotion is running until August 31, so you've still got until the end of the month to take advantage. You'll need to spend at least £69 on eligible products to trigger the discount, but you can combine multiple items to hit the required total.
For example, you could pick up both Super Mario Galaxy 1+2 and Pokémon Legends Z-A for Switch 2. Ordinarily, those two games would set you back £87.90, but the £10 discount brings the total down to £77.90, effectively making each game £38.95.
That's a particularly good pairing if you're looking to bolster your Switch 2 library, and Super Mario Galaxy 1+2 is an especially tempting choice. The collection also includes a free Switch 2 upgrade, meaning you don't need to pay anything extra to get the enhanced version on Nintendo's newer console.
I'd recommend taking a look through Amazon's full selection while the promotion is live, as there are plenty of ways to build an order that clears the £69 threshold and makes the £10 saving worthwhile.
Robert Anderson is IGN's Senior Commerce Editor and resident deals expert on games, collectibles, trading card games, and more. You can follow him @robertliam21 on Bluesky .
